description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.
